span.p:
Registered, unconfirmed
IsActive = true
EmailConfirmed = false
(cannot sign in)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Active
IsActive = true
EmailConfirmed = true
(can sign in)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Inactive
IsActive = false
(cannot sign in or refresh)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Suspend and soft delete both only set IsActive = false,
so they are one stored state and reinstate undoes either.
Repeating suspend, delete or reinstate returns 409.
Reset password (single-use 30-minute token + policy)
changes only the hash and revokes refresh tokens:
IsActive and EmailConfirmed are not checked or changed.
No lockout state, only the per-IP rate limit (429).
